profile:
COMPANY NAME: DISCO
INDUSTRY: Legal Technology (LegalTech) / E-Discovery
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: AI-powered e-discovery software and professional services designed to streamline litigation workflows, automate document review, and accelerate case strategy through advanced research tools.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Law firms (specifically Am Law 200), corporations, and legal professionals handling complex litigation matters.
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise
KEY FEATURES:
- Cecilia Advanced Research: Agentic AI for connecting dots across massive datasets and generating strategy.
- Auto Review with Tag Tuner: AI-powered document review capable of processing 32,000 docs per hour.
- Automated Legal Hold: Reduces manual administrative load by up to 80%.
- Cecilia Q&A: Secure AI tools for investigating fact questions with 87% time savings.
- Cloud-native platform: End-to-end solution covering the entire litigation lifecycle.
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS:
- "Agentic AI" purpose-built for complex legal cases and queries.
- Combination of cutting-edge technology with expert professional services (partnership model).
- Significant efficiency gains: Claims 85% time savings on holds and 98% faster deposition summaries.
- Intuitive, cloud-native design that fits into existing workflows rather than forcing changes.
TONE & POSITIONING: Premium / Enterprise / Innovation-focused
